task: I have a small, read-mostly map from int ids to names (about 50 entries, built once, looked up often). What's the best container?

must_use_any: sorted std::vector of pairs with std::ranges::lower_bound

notes: flat_map fits the access pattern, but libstdc++ 14 doesn't ship it (notes: GCC 14 has no flat_map/flat_set). A sorted vector gives the same layout everywhere.
